concept.verdict: Broad jade pedestal, narrow neck, rounded three-grille head and narrow-root gold fork agree with legacy. Concept substitutes a single central louvre column and raised circular fitting; retain legacy-guided paired grid and actual recessed inspection well instead.

feedback: Actual independent GLB preserves the legacy-guided flared foot, short neck, three open grilles with twenty louvre solids, circular inspection recess and open gold crown.

Three coated body solids and both refined crown arms retain original evaluated geometry; complete mapped colour/roughness pixels and six planar caps/cylindrical side UV contracts pass in saved-native and imported GLB.

The artistic concept simplifies the paired central grid and fills the low circular feature; those differences are not adopted as geometric authority. Concept surface contrast and wear are stronger than the established material maps.

Reduction only affects the ground rim and two neck collars. Medical function is documented; exact inspection engineering, rear surfaces and crown function remain inferred. No operating animation is invented from catalogue reveal/highlight.
